reason: The patch defines `self.downsize` twice in `OptimizedImage` (app/models/optimized_image.rb:145 and app/models/optimized_image.rb:149), so the second 3..4-argument definition overwrites the first in Ruby. As a result, existing 5-argument callers like `Jobs::ResizeEmoji#execute` (app/jobs/regular/resize_emoji.rb:14) will raise `ArgumentError`.
